findings.title: Validate the finite diagnostic tuple and immutable-guard frame before accepting a result

findings.impact: The outer summary can label malformed or internally contradictory component diagnostics PASS_FINITE_PREPARED_SQL_ONLY. This is a source admission defect demonstrated with process-forbidden in-memory mocks, not evidence of an actual PostgreSQL guard failure.
findings.required_correction: Validate exact allowlisted (kind,gate,object) combinations derived from each frozen case diagnostic contract, strict scalar/null types, and expected frame/position semantics. Preserve allowed earlier native SCHEMA/COLUMN gates and selected_column_or_verb_isolation_claimed=False; do not require source positions when legitimate two-line native diagnostics have none. Require IMMUTABLE_GRANT gate=null, object=platform_private.grant_guard, source_frame_verified=True and source_position_verified=False. Native ACL/role/schema/function source_frame_verified must remainFalse.
